structures.description: Broad two-sided trading range that dominates the window from bar 22 through bar 101: repeated rotations between the 2358-2359 floor and the 2607-2609 supply band, with one unconfirmed spike extreme at 2680.00 (bar 70). Single-bar upside climax: bar 70 printed a 2680.00 high and closed 2555.52, an upper tail of roughly 124 points, and price fell back inside the range afterwards, making it an unconfirmed spike high and the reference template for judging the current advance.
Bear swing inside the range: bar 90 reversed from a 2609.02 high to close 2514.07, and bars 91-101 slid to 2358.62 (bar 95 low) and 2370.54 (bar 101 low), setting the base for the current bull leg.

Current bull leg and spike: bars 101-119 rose from the 2370.54 low to a 2700.00 spike high (bar 117), clearing the 2544-2609 resistance band with large trend bars at 112-113; six consecutive closes now sit above the 2609.02 breakout reference, but the leg has not yet pulled back and retested it.

evidence_for: About 100 of the 120 bars trade inside the 2357-2680 envelope, and the two earlier upside thrusts in this window (bar 22 to 2537.57, bar 70 to 2680.00) both reversed within a few bars, so strength at the range top has repeatedly failed here.
The current advance is only about six bars above the 2609.02 breakout reference, and its highest print (2700.00, bar 117) exceeds the earlier spike high (2680.00, bar 70) by only 20 points.

Bar 117 left a roughly 62-point upper tail and bar 119 closed 2633.54 in the lower half of its 2632.22-2658.79 range; the last three closes (2640.01, 2640.01, 2633.54) show the advance stalling rather than accelerating.
Bar ranges are contracting at the high (bar 112 range 89.68, bar 113 range 65.08, bar 119 range 26.57), consistent with a spike losing momentum into resistance rather than a fresh expansion.
No swing low has yet been retested: the leg from 2370.54 to 2700.00 has not produced the pullback-and-hold sequence that would confirm the range top as support.
evidence_against: Bars 102-119 are a genuine 18-bar bull leg with a consistent higher-low sequence (2370.54, 2413.82, 2436.87, 2469.24, 2486.12, 2578.44, 2604.75) and 15 of 18 up closes, so treating it only as a range breakout attempt may understate an emerging bull trend.

Bars 112 (high 2585.50, close 2578.60) and 113 (high 2643.52, close 2636.28) are large bull trend bars that cleared the 2544-2609 band, and every close since (2612.02 to 2640.01) has held above 2609.02, which is short-term acceptance of the breakout.
Bar 117's 2700.00 print is a new high for the entire 120-bar window, so the market is not merely retesting the bar-70 spike high from below.

There has been no bear reversal bar since the leg began; the largest down close in bars 102-119 is 2448.74 (bar 107), far above the leg origin, and the strongest pullback low is 2604.75 (bar 115), only about 95 points below the 2700.00 high.
transition_conditions: Follow-through: additional closes above 2658.79 and a pullback that holds above 2609.02 would confirm acceptance of the breakout and support shifting the phase from breakout-spike toward a bull channel/trend read.
Failure: a close back below 2604.75 (bar 115 low) and then below 2578.60 (bar 112 close) would mark the breakout as failed and restore the trading-range read with the top near the 2609-2700 band.

Reversal attempt: a large bear bar closing near its low that takes out 2608.83 (bar 114 low) and then 2495.82 (bar 112 low) would mirror the bar-70 and bar-90 reversal precedents and move the read toward transition-unclear.

Range formation at the high: continued range contraction with overlapping bars confined between roughly 2612 and 2658 would indicate the spike is becoming a small trading range at resistance, changing the phase to range.

Wide double bottom 20 days apart: 2357.18 (open_time 1788336000000) and 2358.62 (open_time 1789488000000), the two window lows that frame the range; the 2544.63 range top break sits above them.

evidence_for: About 100 of the 120 bars overlap between 2357.18 and 2544.63, with repeated failures at 2528.80, 2537.57, 2544.63 and 2545.29; the window's center of gravity is a wide two-sided range, not a sustained directional move.

Upside probes in this window have not held: the 2680.00 bar (open_time 1789128000000) and the 2609.02 bar (open_time 1789416000000) both reversed back into the range, and the latter preceded a decline to 2358.62.
The advance from 2370.54 is a single 18-bar leg; there is no prior pullback-and-higher-high channel sequence to confirm it, and its two largest bars are spike-type bars closing near their highs.
After the spike the last four bars are a tight doji cluster with a 2700.00 upper tail, i.e., two-sided trading at the high instead of follow-through trend bars.
evidence_against: Nine consecutive closes above the 2544.63 range top (roughly 3% above it) is acceptance rather than a mere overshoot, and the window's highest closes (2640.01, 2636.28, 2633.54) all occurred in the final six bars.

Price cleared both the 2609.02 prior swing high and the earlier 2680.00 spike high, and the last close 2632.98 is above every close in the preceding 114 bars, which argues for a bull trend rather than a range.
The 2357.18/2358.62 double bottom with the 2544.63 top broken gives a measured-move context near 2730, so the stall at 2700.00 can be read as a pause at a target rather than a range top.
Rising lows since 2370.54 and only small down closes in the last fifteen bars keep the Always-In long, and no bar has yet closed back inside the range.
transition_conditions: A close back below 2544.63 would confirm the range-top breakout failed and restore the wide-range read (bull trap).
A bar closing above 2700.00 near its high would shift the primary regime from trading-range to bull-trend and mark the spike as the start of a channel.
A close below the 2495.82 low of the first breakout bar would break the spike's structure and put the 2604.75/2618.80 higher lows at risk.
Continued tight 2618.80-2658.79 overlap with no new high would leave the read as a breakout-spike pause, i.e., a possible final flag inside the larger range.

Tight seven-bar range at the highs, bars 113-119, with heavy overlap, small bodies and boundaries 2604.75-2658.79; bar 120 broke below its lower edge and closed under it, so this coil resolved downward on the final bar without follow-through.

Possible reversal candidate only: bar 89's 2609.02 high with a close near the low, a selloff to 2358.62, then a bull channel to a marginal new high at 2700.00 (bar 116, 20.00 above bar 69's 2680.00) with a 61.51 upper tail, followed by bar 120's bear bar closing near its low below the seven-bar range low. No lower high below 2700.00 or trend-structure break has occurred yet, so this is an unconfirmed pattern, not a reversal.

evidence_for: Bars 95-116 produced a clean sequence of higher swing lows (2370.54, 2438.33, 2495.82) and higher highs (2438.47, 2481.66, 2643.52, 2700.00), the defining bull-trend progression.

Bars 111-112 are two consecutive strong bull bars closing in the top quarter of their ranges and above every prior swing high in the window except bar 69's spike high, which is a Brooks-style breakout rather than a single-bar poke.
Acceptance followed the breakout: bars 113-119 held entirely above 2604.75, i.e. above the 2544.63/2537.57 pre-breakout top and above bar 111's 2585.50 high.

The final close 2586.68 is still above the pre-breakout range top (2544.63/2537.57) and above bar 111's 2585.50 high, so price has not re-entered the prior range and the last-bar bearishness is a one-bar pullback so far.
evidence_against: Most of the window is balance, not trend: roughly 90 bars (bars 28-110) overlap between 2411 and 2609, so the current leg is a 10-26 bar overshoot from a long two-sided range rather than an established trend.

Bar 116's 2700.00 exceeded bar 69's 2680.00 by only 20.00 (about 0.7%) and closed 61.51 below its high - a marginal new high with a long tail, the classic shape of a buy climax at the top of a range rather than a fresh trending breakout.
Bar 120 is a bear bar closing 17.12 above its 2569.80 low that broke below the 2604.75 low of bars 113-119 and erased four bars of gains, creating a potential lower high at 2700.00.

Bars 113-119 were a flat, heavily overlapping coil rather than a sloping channel, so the leg is losing momentum (channel flattening toward a range, a common precursor to a deeper pullback or reversal).

Bar 89 shows the same failure pattern near 2600 (bull push to 2609.02, close 2514.07, then a 250-point drop to 2358.62), demonstrating that this market recently punished upside attempts from this zone.
transition_conditions: Bull resumption: a close above 2658.79 (bar 118 high) followed by acceptance above 2700.00 would re-confirm the breakout and keep the trend/always-in read long.
Pullback extension: two consecutive closes below 2569.80 (bar 120 low) would confirm the seven-bar range is breaking down and put the 2537.57-2544.63 pre-breakout top in play.
Structure break: a close below 2495.82 (bar 111 low) would end the higher-low sequence and confirm an mtr-like reversal, shifting the regime away from bull-trend.
Range-lock: repeated closes back inside roughly 2540-2610 without a new high above 2700.00 would recast 2600-2700 as a new trading range and drop always-in relevance.

Spike-and-channel bull leg from the 2358.62 double-bottom higher low to the window high 2700, breaking above the 2537.57 and 2609.02 prior range tops with two large trend bars and seven closes holding above 2609.02.

Tight 7-bar flag at the top of the bull leg (2604.75-2658.79) including a rejected intraday poke to 2700 (bar 1789804800000, close 2638.49); the last two bars (1789862400000, 1789876800000) broke the flag low and closed back below 2609.02.

Reversal candidate, not confirmed: bull leg into a marginal new window high 2700 at a round number with a bearish close (2638.49) and a lower high since, followed by two bear bars breaking the 7-bar flag and the 2609.02 breakout level. No confirmed break of the leg's higher low yet.

evidence_for: Higher low plus higher high on the window's major swings: 2358.62 (bar 1789488000000) sits above the earlier 2357.18 (bar 1788336000000), and 2700 (bar 1789804800000) exceeds the earlier window high 2680 (bar 1789128000000) and the 2609.02 range top, so the latest leg broke to new window highs.

Trend-bar quality with follow-through: bars 1789732800000 and 1789747200000 closed near their highs with minimal overlap, and the next seven closes (2612.02 to 2640.01) all held above the 2609.02 breakout level, which is acceptance rather than a one-bar poke.

The pullback is small relative to the leg: from 2700 the market retraced only to 2569.8/2570 (~38% of the 2358.62-to-2700 leg) and remains above the 2537.57 prior swing high and far above the 2495.82 low of spike bar 1789732800000, so the leg's higher-low structure is intact.

Reversal evidence: a lower high below 2700 followed by a break of 2569.8/2570 (lows of the last two bars) with follow-through would turn the 2700 poke into a failed-breakout top within the range.

structures.description: Broad two-sided trading range spanning the whole window; floor anchored by 2357.18 and 2358.62, ceiling by 2680.00 and 2700.00. Legs overlap with repeated reversals and no sustained one-directional sequence.

evidence_for: Across 120 bars price repeatedly reversed inside the 2357.18-2700 band: a 2357-2359 double bottom, a 2680 spike that closed 124.48 below its high, a two-sided 2464.27-2609.02 congestion, a 2358.62 retest, and a 2700 probe that closed 61.51 below its high.
Overlap and reversal count dominate: bodies in the 2464-2609 congestion repeatedly overlap and no more than a few trend bars run consecutively in either direction.
The 2700 high exceeded the earlier 2680.00 high by only 20 points and closed back inside the prior range, so acceptance above the top is unproven.
evidence_against: Strongest counterargument: from the 2358.62 low (open 1789488000000) the sequence steps up in both highs and lows into 2700, which is a directional bull leg rather than rotation, and it includes large trend bars at opens 1789732800000 (2507.15 to 2578.60) and 1789747200000 (2579.97 to 2636.28).
The pullback from 2700 to 2568.16 retraces roughly half of the 2436.87-2700 advance and has not broken the last higher low, which is normal bull-trend behaviour rather than proof of a range top.
A window high at 2700 following a 2358.62 higher low can also be read as a bull channel inside a wider range, which would put the current pullback in the channel rather than at a range ceiling.
transition_conditions: Acceptance above 2700.00 - a close above it followed by another bull close - would move the read toward a bull breakout/trend rather than a range ceiling.
A close below 2568.16 followed by a lower high would confirm the 2700 rejection and favour rotation back toward the 2464-2507 area.
Continued small overlapping bars holding roughly 2568-2640 keeps the trading-range classification intact.
A break and close below 2436.87 would revive the bearish swing leg from opens 1789473600000-1789488000000.
